prompt: Top-down, photo-real macro of a blind-embossed dry seal pressed into cool neutral white security paper (#ECEBE8, not cream, not yellow). Relief only, no ink at all: an outer ring of raised beads, two raised concentric rings, a band of fine raised radial ridges, and a delicate guilloche rosette of interlaced raised lines in the centre. Soft raking light from the top-left gives each ridge a bright edge and a soft shadow. NO letters, NO numbers, NO text, NO emblem, NO crest. Square frame, the seal centred occupying about 80% of the width, with plain paper around it; the paper tone and grain are uniform right to the edges so it blends into a page.
